title: The corpus posterior after two weeks: updating the explanation probabilities for the LZ 248 keV event with P001-P099
question: Combining the quantitative results of the corpus, what are the updated probabilities of the dossier's explanation classes A-K, how robust are they to the judgemental inputs, which papers carried the information, and which classes moved most?
headline_result: Dossier prior x corpus event-likelihoods (30 cited factors, 200000 log-uniform MC draws) gives F artefact/unknowns 0.64 (0.31-0.87), inelastic DM 0.23 (0.07-0.50), modelled-background fluctuation 0.033, every other class < 0.01, wall MSSI 1.6e-4; P(DM) = 0.25 (0.08-0.54), controlled 60% by the artefact likelihood L_F and 29% by the forking-paths divisor f_FP; B fell 3.1 dex, G/K/D/H/C/E 1.1-1.9 dex
model_or_mechanism: posterior_i = pi_i L_i / sum pi_j L_j; L_i = product of corpus factors (rates, sideband k posteriors Gamma(2,1/3.23) and UDT-weighted k_E, position, veto, hit-pattern, tail-shape, date odds, P027 B_DM x b_H / f_FP, class shares, UV-survival)
stance: statistical reassessment (neutral: conventional backgrounds eliminated; residual prior-dominated between artefact/unknown and inelastic DM)
result_type: computed (posterior algebra, Monte Carlo) / estimated (factor ranges are corpus judgements)
confidence: medium - algebra exact and cross-checked against P004/P061/P093; class likelihoods inherit corpus judgements and the dossier prior partly double-counts the event
agent_tools: Read x18, Bash x17, Write x6, Edit x16, Skill x1 (dataviz)
software_and_packages: python 3.12.13; numpy 2.5.3; pandas 3.0.5; matplotlib 3.11.2 (Agg); common/lzcommon.py (import check); Bayesian algebra by hand
local_inputs: PAPER_GUIDE; dossier S2/S4/S5; results_ledger.csv (95 rows); P041/P061/P083/P090/P093/P094/P099.md; P061 details S1.3/S4.4; P093.json; ENVIRONMENT_versions.txt
recalled_knowledge: 3 (Poisson colouring theorem; Gamma posterior for a Poisson scale with 1/k prior; KL divergence as information) - all certain
data_dependence: none (L_F would tighten with DR-003 via P093)
